-- REQ: LANG-2401 LANG-2402 LANG-2403 LANG-2404
Greeting DEFINITIONS AUTOMATIC TAGS ::= BEGIN
-- A person
Person ::= SEQUENCE {
    name   UTF8String (SIZE (1..64)),
    age    INTEGER (0..150) OPTIONAL,
    emails SEQUENCE OF IA5String,
    active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE
}
Color ::= ENUMERATED { red(0), green(1) }
END
